name: decision-records-index
description: How the repo is built is decided in docs/decisions/: 0001 the agentic scaffold (Tier M, review kit, push gate by ancestry with clean merges of main), 0002 TypeScript+Next.js (App Router)+Vitest+Biome in one package (Jared chose Next.js on 2026-11-05). Read the record before changing what it decides; supersede, never contradict.
A guard test whose fixture contains the very string it forbids (a design-doc artifact URL in tests/guards/design-links.test.ts) fails on its own repo-wide scan.
resolution: Build the forbidden string from parts in the fixture (['https://claude.ai','artifact','abc'].join('/')), and keep the matcher's regex escaped so its source does not match itself.

description: Biome 2.6 formats Markdown by default. 'biome check --write .' padded every table in the exported design docs and put a blank line inside skill frontmatter (after the opening ---), which breaks the skill.
resolution: biome.json excludes **/*.md (files.includes). Markdown is never machine-formatted here: the design snapshots must stay byte-for-byte what the export produced.

description: A guard's file filter written as !path.includes('.') on a repo-relative path skips every extensionless file under a dot-directory (.githooks/pre-push), so the guard never scans the hook scripts it meant to cover.
resolution: Test the basename for an extension, not the whole path, and assert in the guard's repo scan that a dot-directory file such as .githooks/pre-push is included.

description: Playwright resolves in cloud sessions only through NODE_PATH (a preinstalled global copy), not package.json; a script that requires it, run as a README says, fails off the cloud VM after npm ci.
resolution: Say in the run instructions that Playwright and Chromium must be installed outside a cloud session (reference/README.md does), or add playwright as a devDependency if a script must run in CI.

content: The mirror is a build output: never hand-edit it. Tab order comes from the docs table in docs/design/README.md. The docs hold current state only; a replaced rule gets a row in docs/design/decision-log.md, and passages worth keeping word for word go to docs/design/archive/. tests/guards/scan.ts skips out/ because the built page quotes artifact links. design-mirror.test.mjs fails if a link between design docs points at a missing heading.

description: design-mirror.mjs heading ids diverged from GitHub anchors: marked escapes ' to ' (numeric entities survived an &[a-z]+; strip), duplicates got -2 not -1, and separator runs collapsed, so the link test would reject GitHub-correct anchors
resolution: Slug the decoded heading text like github-slugger (no collapsing, -1 for the first duplicate); tested with an apostrophe and an em dash

description: Consolidating design docs, a Proposed detail (Dispel's stripping rule) was put in the same paragraph as a Decided rule (only Dispel targets a spell) under one 'Decided' heading, which promoted it without a source
resolution: When merging text from several docs, carry each sentence's own Decided/Proposed/Open status. A status at the start of a paragraph covers every sentence in it, so split the paragraph when the statuses differ

name: rune-reference-parser-check
description: docs/design/rune-reference.md is parsed by the rune dashboard (app/design/runes/reference.ts). Before changing its sections or table shapes, run that parser's test against the new doc: on an unmerged dashboard branch, add a git worktree of it, copy the doc in, symlink node_modules, and run npx vitest run app/design/runes (the stone test needs three installed and can be ignored). Then tell the dashboard thread which sections changed.
Replacing a design rule in rune-reference.md or system-b.md left the old rule in engine-model.md (output kinds, aspects, re-aim step) and effect-flags-checklist.md, which also describe it
resolution: When a design rule is replaced, grep docs/design/ (engine-model.md and effect-flags-checklist.md included, archive/ excluded) for the old wording, and update every copy in the same change

description: Nov 6 decisions that changed what the reference crafter computes (opposites no longer cancel, new Slow/Haste/Protect/Dispel centers, damage sharing preset dropped) left reference/README.md's out-of-date list and seed spellcrafter-5f29 describing only the Nov 5 drift, though the README names the crafter's script as the reference for the engine port
resolution: When a design decision changes a rule the crafter or audit tool encodes, add it to reference/README.md's Out of date paragraph and to the crafter-update seed in the same change

description: Moving a doc's Open list to a new home (rune-reference to system-c.md), items were dropped under a 'center-only' rule that did not apply to them (Air vs Space), and decision-log rows kept calling things Open whose new home did not list them.
resolution: When moving or pruning an Open list, check each removed item against the stated drop rule one by one, and grep decision-log.md for 'is Open' claims whose 'Where it lives now' link must still list them.

description: Writing up a rune's row, an Open item that overlapped with another rune was rewritten as resolved ('Air and Spatial are now apart') from the author's reading of the new core, while the new row's own ground cell still moved units
resolution: An Open item changes only on Jared's words, cited with the time; before narrowing one, check the new cells against the claim
